[ASSISTANT] Disneyland's Halloween Time starts in mid-September, featuring festive decorations, themed food, and special entertainment, including the Halloween-themed parade and 'Oogie Boogie Bash.'  
[ASSISTANT] Knott's Berry Farm's Halloween event, Knott's Scary Farm, features haunted mazes, scare zones, and live entertainment.  
[ASSISTANT] Six Flags Magic Mountain's Fright Fest includes haunted mazes, scare zones, and themed rides from late September to early November.  
[ASSISTANT] Universal Studios Hollywood's Halloween Horror Nights runs from mid-September to early November with elaborate haunted houses, scare zones, and thrilling rides.  
[ASSISTANT] Recommended food items at Disneyland include Pumpkin Beignets, Mummy Dogs, Bat Wing Chicken Tenders, and Candy Corn Funnel Cake.
